definitions.explanation: The quality of being interesting, fun, or amusing. Formed by attaching the abstract-noun suffix 〜さ to the い-adjective {面白|おもしろ}い. Refers to the inherent attractiveness or interest-value of something — a book, a sport, an activity, a person's talk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面白|おもしろ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I came to understand what makes this book interesting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面白|おもしろ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He taught me how interesting math can be.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面白|おもしろ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{予想外|よそうがい}→予想外：03188_yosougai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The appeal of this movie lies in its unexpected plot twists.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧ using the 〜さ suffix, which turns an adjective into an abstract noun for its quality. Used both for "fun" in the everyday sense and "interest / appeal" in a more analytical sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {面白|おもしろ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to come to appreciate (something's) appeal
- {面白|おもしろ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to convey the appeal of
- {面白|おもしろ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気付|きづ}く→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧: to notice the appeal of
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面白|おもしろ}さ: the fun of the game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {楽|たの}しさ: enjoyment; fun — focuses on the emotional pleasure, not analytical interest
- ⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧: interest (in something) — your inclination toward it, not the thing's inherent appeal
